description: Request a JS reload for a supported app using DevSettings in development or installed expo-updates where available. For an unresponsive app, can try its known dev server when reachable. Recovery is not guaranteed. Reload can discard in-memory state and evidence; collect needed observations first when possible. By default waits for reconnection up to timeoutMs. Needs configured @buoy-gg/core support. Works on the free tier.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out. Or "All" to reload every connected app.

strategy.description: Reload mechanism. 'auto' (default) uses DevSettings in dev builds and expo-updates otherwise. Force one only when debugging the reload itself.

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the app to reconnect, in ms. Default 30000.

wait.description: Wait for the app to come back before returning. Default true — turn off for fire-and-forget.

name: reload_app
